Minor — XR panel ergonomics.

Minor — AR placement is head-relative only.
Evidence: no hit-test or anchors in optionalFeatures.

Minor — rendering polish and resource use.
Evidence: no env map, so metallic parts look dull. setFoveation(1) blurs peripheral text. A palette change triggers a full recompute.

A robust, well-engineered submission. The main weakness is the visual centrepiece: a mid-resolution vertex-coloured heightfield that gains no detail when zooming.
The app code also ships minified, which hurts maintainability.
